workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: download_dev_deps.py rejects macOS arm64 PDFium archive due to missing bundled libc++ libraries
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(deps): do not require bundled libc++ in macOS pdfium-static archives. Target files: tools/scripts/download_dev_deps.py, build.sh, tools/scripts/native_lib_version.sh. In `tools/scripts/download_dev_deps.py`, `main()` unconditionally requires `lib/libc++.a` and `lib/libc++abi.a` when validating the extracted `pdfium-static` archive: However, `kognitos/pdfium-static` only bundles `lib/libc++.a` and `lib/libc++abi.a` in the Linux archives (`pdfium-linux-{x64,arm64}-static.tgz`, which `build.sh` links with `-fuse-ld=lld`... (Ref: https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow/pull/21997)

workarounds.symptom: [Question]: After re-building the ragflow image and running "docker-compose up -d", an error occurred.
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(beartype): remove package-wide import hooks. Target files: deepdoc/__init__.py, pyproject.toml, sdk/python/ragflow_sdk/__init__.py. Removed unnecessary beartype hooks from three package imports. This prevents unwanted import-time instrumentation and dependency coupling. based on #15258 (Ref: https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow/pull/19531)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: rag/utils/{es_conn,opensearch_conn}.py write/delete paths silently swallow transient errors

Fix the silent-failure health-check retry loops in `common/doc_store/{es_conn_pool, ob_conn_pool, infinity_conn_pool, infinity_conn_base}.py`.
